description: Niederflur Einlieferung im Sollfahrplan is a dataset listed in SBB open data platform, an open data platform of a railway operator, published or maintained by SBB (Swiss Federal Railways). Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Traffic. The portal shows 2023-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://opentransportdata.swiss/de/terms-of-use/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sbb-open-data-portal.
